# macOS output clock patch

This directory contains the CPAL 0.15.3 crates.io release, including its Apache-2.0 license. The package archive SHA-256 is `873dab07c8f743075e57f524c583985fbaf745602acbe916a01539364369a779`. Its source commit is `ac6cbb2ba55e61665a35ab88ae136a83380d1354`.

The upstream macOS output callback queried the Mach timebase on every buffer. When the OS query failed, CPAL formatted an owned error description and locked the error callback mutex to deliver it. The application then destroyed the description on return from its callback. [Timestamp conversion and error construction](https://github.com/RustAudio/cpal/blob/ac6cbb2ba55e61665a35ab88ae136a83380d1354/src/host/coreaudio/mod.rs#L32-L39) · [Upstream output callback](https://github.com/RustAudio/cpal/blob/ac6cbb2ba55e61665a35ab88ae136a83380d1354/src/host/coreaudio/macos/mod.rs#L670-L708)

The local changes are confined to `src/host/coreaudio/macos/mod.rs` and the new `output_clock.rs`. Stream construction checks the Mach status and conversion ratio before installing the output callback. Failure propagates as a build error through the ordinary Play RPC or hot-reload error path. The callback captures two integers and converts host ticks using widened integer arithmetic. Even repeated initialization failures create zero pending callback errors, and shutdown has no error queue to drain. An unused upstream import was removed from the modified module.

CPAL retains its stream-control locks and its property-listener mutex for device disconnects on explicitly selected devices. The default-output configuration used by Phase 0 delegates device selection to CoreAudio and skips that disconnect listener. This patch covers the macOS output timestamp path. Input, other platforms, and OS internals have separate realtime behavior. [Device selection](https://github.com/RustAudio/cpal/blob/ac6cbb2ba55e61665a35ab88ae136a83380d1354/src/host/coreaudio/macos/enumerate.rs#L121-L148) · [Disconnect handling](https://github.com/RustAudio/cpal/blob/ac6cbb2ba55e61665a35ab88ae136a83380d1354/src/host/coreaudio/macos/mod.rs#L446-L471)
